criteria.title: Backup registry and operational commands are exposed as MCP tools
criteria.given: an MCP client asks the Bahia MCP server for tools
criteria.then: apply repository, policy, recipe, definition, probe, run, verification, restore, approval/rejection, and retention tools are present

criteria.title: Mutating backup MCP tools preserve Nostr-native command semantics
criteria.when: a backup mutating MCP tool is invoked
criteria.then: the tool requires an idempotency key for the addressable d tag, calls the backup command publisher, and returns request/result/status correlation metadata instead of directly executing backup completion logic

criteria.title: Backup read-model MCP tools expose durable backup state
criteria.when: list or inspect backup tools are invoked
criteria.then: the tools return repositories, policies, recipes, definitions, runs, restores, retention runs, and single-record details including run verification evidence where available

criteria.title: Missing MCP dependencies fail closed
criteria.given: backup command or read-model dependencies are not configured
criteria.when: a backup MCP tool requiring that dependency is invoked
criteria.then: the tool returns an MCP error result and does not create fake backup state
